messages:
Asha (Design): Quick concept drop: inline p95 label with a tiny 'Capture rate' toggle next to it (no extra row). Goal: show sampling state without expanding vertical space. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzzzz. Thoughts?

Noah (Eng-UX): Love compactness. Concern: discoverability + keyboard access. If it's inline, ensure it's tabbable and has clear focus affordance. Maybe add small chevron to open slider.

Rina (Research): From testing: users glance at p95 card, not the timeline. If sampling changes numbers, they need a badge that reads like 'sampled • 15%'. Also test wording: 'Capture rate' beats 'Sampling' in clarity.

Omar (PM): Product note: defaults differ by tier. Add a microcopy hint: 'Lower capture = lower cost, less precise p95'. We should surface that on hover or in the popover.

Lee (DesignOps): Accessibility items: 1) contrast on tiny badge in dark theme, 2) focus ring visible when over heatmap, 3) aria-label must read current percent. Also make popover closable with Esc.

Noah (Eng-UX): Keyboard flow proposal: focus p95 label -> press Enter -> popover slider -> arrows update value -> aria-live announces new percent. Keep tab order predictable.

Asha (Design): I'll iterate two variants: inline badge + popover slider, and alternate where capture control lives in timepicker presets (e.g., 'Last 1h (sampled)'). Will add accessible annotations and share updated prototype later today.

infra-bot: Note created: ticket INF-1422 to add sampling metadata to query API (response flag + percent).
